subject: Pricing + estimate for Northbound.ai — deck attached
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rowe <erowe@northbound.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing + estimate for Northbound.ai — deck attached

Hi Ethan — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Key priorities you mentioned: reducing request latency for conversational agents, predictable per-token spend, and private deployments for PII-sensitive flows.
- Recommended config (high level): use r-infer-large quantized for steady-state; Dedicated pool for predictable throughput; caching for prefixes.

I attached a short pricing + estimate packet that walks through: pricing tiers, Dedicated sizing options, and a 90-day migration checklist (see attachment).

Attachments: Est-Redwood-Northbound-20261113.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 15-min walkthrough of the deck so I can answer pricing questions — I can do Tue/Wed next week (11/17–11/18) between 10a–2p PT.
2) If you want an ops deep-dive, loop in your infra lead and we can schedule a 30–45m session.

If this is still a priority, which slot works best? If timing has shifted, let me know where this sits on your roadmap and I’ll follow up accordingly.

Thanks — happy to chat through any of the assumptions in the estimate.

--
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rowe <erowe@northbound.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:52:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing + estimate for Northbound.ai — deck attached

Hi Ethan — just nudging this up in case the estimate landed in a busy inbox. Quick notes in case helpful:

- The estimate assumes 1.5M tokens/mo for evaluation with a conservative concurrency target. We can scale down the Dedicated recommendation if you prefer to start with hosted and move to Dedicated for production.
- We also included an optional SRE office-hours slot for onboarding help (one 2-hour session).

If you're still evaluating, totally understood — can you confirm whether this remains a priority for Q4? If not, a quick reply with "pause" or an ETA is perfect. Otherwise, if a walkthrough would help, I can lock a 15-minute slot — proposed: Tue 11/17 at 10:30am PT or Wed 11/18 at 1:00pm PT.

Thanks,
Mateo

- Can you confirm the per-token rate in the estimate for the quantized variant?
- Is there a short-term hosted option if we want to defer Dedicated for now (we expect traffic ramp in ~3 months)?

A walkthrough would help — I can do Tue 11/17 afternoon PT or Wed 11/18 in the morning PT. If you can send a 15-min invite for one of those, I’ll add our infra lead (Camille) to the meeting.

Thanks,
